name: gildas-vigor-wakes-up-at-end-of-turn
notes: Gildas (g99PIuhU0O): "Stealth, Vigor". Vigor (HasVigor -> end-phase wake up in Custom/GameLogic.php) makes the unit ready itself at the end of its controller's turn. Player 1's champion is Mordred, Burnished Avenger; Gildas' [REST] ability is used in the main phase (two reserve payments, the champion is the target) which leaves Gildas rested, then player 1 ends the turn and Gildas is found awake again.

rulesClauses: Vigor: a unit with Vigor wakes up at the end of its controller's turn.
[REST] cost: using the ability rests Gildas.
